newsitem.title: GERMANY: ACL launches Zaire emergency aid flights.
newsitem.headline: ACL launches Zaire emergency aid flights.

text.p: An airbridge service to carry emergency aid shipments from Europe to Zairean refugees has been set up, German freight forwarder Air Cargo Logistics (ACL) said on Thursday.

ACL managing director Thomas Rinnert said two DC-8 freighters with up to 50 tonnes capacity were standing by at Cologne and Ostend airports to transport goods non-stop to the war-torn Zaire border region.
"We can fly straight away and as often as necessary. We have had many calls from emergency organisations over the last two days and now the service is ready," he told Reuters.
Flights would be operated by a Belgian airline with Zaire traffic rights into Kisangani airport in northern Zaire, he said.
From there, small aircraft such as DC-3s, DC-6s and Antonov-28s were available to distribute throughout the war zone around Goma, he added.
"Kisangani airport is open, there is no war situation and fuelling and cargo warehousing is available. Logistics operations there are under our management," he said.
"We have decided to use small aircraft for distribution as they can cover the area better and land on grass," he added.
